name: Those Who Remain
desc:
Survive endless waves of infected while looting for items to keep you, and your friends, alive. Build defenses, complete objectives, and hold out before the horde overruns you. One of Roblox's original zombie survival experiences.

Programming & Game Design - nin900500
Creative Associate - GoAirborne
Infected Sounds - B. Chuck & Friend
Infected Animations - spas12kick
Dog & Reindeer Animations - nocturnaliss
Additional Game Assets - bioxx03, Mustrive, AbsolutelyGarbage134, Neu
Music Composition - Director1406
Original Creative Direction & Assets - Ardwyck

Exploiting, glitching, or cheating in the game can result in your account's data being reset, which includes negation of Developer Product purchases.
